def transform(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # find separator line (full row or col of same nonzero color c, appearing many times)
    import collections
    # row line
    line=None
    for i in range(h):
        r=collections.Counter(g[i])
        c,n=r.most_common(1)[0]
        if c!=0 and n>=w*0.9 and len([x for x in g[i] if x==c])>=w-1: line=('h',i,c)
    for j in range(w):
        col=[g[i][j] for i in range(h)]
        c,n=collections.Counter(col).most_common(1)[0]
        if c!=0 and n>=h*0.9: line=('v',j,c)
    if line is None: return g
    o,pos,c=line
    # object cells: all non-background, non-line cells
    from collections import Counter
    flat=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=flat.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j] not in (bg,c)]
    if not cells: return g
    if o=='h':
        top=min(i for i,j in cells); bot=max(i for i,j in cells)
        if bot<pos: shift=pos-1-bot   # move down until adjacent
        elif top>pos: shift=pos+1-top
        else: shift=0
        new={}
        for i,j in cells: new[(i+shift,j)]=g[i][j]
        # 8-line parallel on far side
        t=min(i for i,j in new); b=max(i for i,j in new)
        e=t-1 if pos<b or pos<t-0 else b+1
        e = t-1 if t>pos else b+1
        out=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
        for (i,j),v in new.items(): out[i][j]=v
        for j in range(w): out[e][j]=8
    else:
        left=min(j for i,j in cells); right=max(j for i,j in cells)
        if right<pos: shift=pos-1-right
        elif left>pos: shift=pos+1-left
        else: shift=0
        new={}
        for i,j in cells: new[(i,j+shift)]=g[i][j]
        l=min(j for i,j in new); rr=max(j for i,j in new)
        e = l-1 if l>pos else rr+1
        out=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
        for (i,j),v in new.items(): out[i][j]=v
        for i in range(h): out[i][e]=8
    return out
